mapper.sql: USER_ID AS userId, EMAIL AS email, USER_NAME AS userName, STATUS AS status, USER_ROLE AS userRole, PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH AS profileImagePath, PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH AS profileOriginalImagePath, PROFILE_CROP_SCALE AS profileCropScale, PROFILE_CROP_X AS profileCropX, PROFILE_CROP_Y AS profileCropY, NVL(PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT') AS profileAvatarType, PROFILE_INTRO AS profileIntro, TO_CHAR(BIRTH_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birthDate, BIRTH_CALENDAR_TYPE AS birthCalendarType, BIRTH_PUBLIC_YN AS birthPublicYn, NVL(PROFILE_PHOTOS_PUBLIC_YN, 'Y') AS profilePhotosPublicYn, NVL(PROFILE_NOTES_PUBLIC_YN, 'Y') AS profileNotesPublicYn, NVL(PROFILE_CALENDAR_PUBLIC_YN, 'Y') AS profileCalendarPublicYn, NVL(PROFILE_GROUPS_PUBLIC_YN, 'Y') AS profileGroupsPublicYn, NVL((SELECT SCHEDULE_ALARM_YN FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS S WHERE S.USER_ID = USERS.USER_ID), 'Y') AS notifyScheduleYn, NVL((SELECT SHARE_ALARM_YN FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS S WHERE S.USER_ID = USERS.USER_ID), 'Y') AS notifyShareYn, NVL((SELECT REQUEST_ALARM_YN FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS S WHERE S.USER_ID = USERS.USER_ID), 'Y') AS notifyRequestYn, NVL((SELECT COMMENT_ALARM_YN FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS S WHERE S.USER_ID = USERS.USER_ID), 'Y') AS notifyCommentYn, NVL((SELECT LIKE_ALARM_YN FROM USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS S WHERE S.USER_ID = USERS.USER_ID), 'Y') AS notifyLikeYn, TO_CHAR(WITHDRAW_REQUESTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS withdrawRequestedAt, TO_CHAR(WITHDRAW_DEADLINE_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS withdrawDeadlineAt
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_USER_ID.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, EMAIL, PWD_HASH, USER_NAME, STATUS, USER_ROLE, PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, PROFILE_CROP_X, PROFILE_CROP_Y, PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, PROFILE_INTRO, BIRTH_DATE, BIRTH_CALENDAR_TYPE, BIRTH_PUBLIC_YN, PROFILE_PHOTOS_PUBLIC_YN, PROFILE_NOTES_PUBLIC_YN, PROFILE_CALENDAR_PUBLIC_YN, PROFILE_GROUPS_PUBLIC_YN ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{email}, #{pwdHash}, #{userName}, #{status}, #{userRole}, #{profileImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileOriginalImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileCropScale, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileCropX, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileCropY, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, NVL(#{profileAvatarType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DEFAULT'), #{profileIntro, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASE WHEN #{birthDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TO_DATE(#{birthDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END, NVL(#{birthCalendarType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'SOLAR'), NVL(#{birthPublicYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{profilePhotosPublicYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{profileNotesPublicYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{profileCalendarPublicYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{profileGroupsPublicYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y') )
mapper.update:
UPDATE USERS
USER_NAME = #{userName}, PROFILE_INTRO = #{profileIntro, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, STATUS = #{status},
PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH = NULL, PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH = NULL, PROFILE_CROP_SCALE = NULL, PROFILE_CROP_X = NULL, PROFILE_CROP_Y = NULL, PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE = 'DEFAULT',
PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH = #{profileImagePath}, PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH = #{profileOriginalImagePath}, PROFILE_CROP_SCALE = #{profileCropScale}, PROFILE_CROP_X = #{profileCropX}, PROFILE_CROP_Y = #{profileCropY}, PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE = #{profileAvatarType},
BIRTH_DATE = NULL, BIRTH_DATE = TO_DATE(#{birthDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
BIRTH_CALENDAR_TYPE = #{birthCalendarType}, BIRTH_PUBLIC_YN = #{birthPublicYn}, PROFILE_PHOTOS_PUBLIC_YN = #{profilePhotosPublicYn}, PROFILE_NOTES_PUBLIC_YN = #{profileNotesPublicYn}, PROFILE_CALENDAR_PUBLIC_YN = #{profileCalendarPublicYn}, PROFILE_GROUPS_PUBLIC_YN = #{profileGroupsPublicYn},
WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

MERGE INTO USER_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS S USING (SELECT #{userId} AS USER_ID FROM DUAL) D ON (S.USER_ID = D.USER_ID) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET SCHEDULE_ALARM_YN = NVL(#{notifyScheduleYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, S.SCHEDULE_ALARM_YN), SHARE_ALARM_YN = NVL(#{notifyShareYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, S.SHARE_ALARM_YN), REQUEST_ALARM_YN = NVL(#{notifyRequestYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, S.REQUEST_ALARM_YN), COMMENT_ALARM_YN = NVL(#{notifyCommentYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, S.COMMENT_ALARM_YN), LIKE_ALARM_YN = NVL(#{notifyLikeYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, S.LIKE_ALARM_YN), UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_ID, SCHEDULE_ALARM_YN, SHARE_ALARM_YN, REQUEST_ALARM_YN, COMMENT_ALARM_YN, LIKE_ALARM_YN, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, NVL(#{notifyScheduleYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{notifyShareYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{notifyRequestYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{notifyCommentYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), NVL(#{notifyLikeYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y'), SYSDATE )
UPDATE USER_PROFILE_IMAGES SET IS_CURRENT = 'N' WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND IS_CURRENT = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PROFILE_IMAGES ( PROFILE_IMAGE_ID, USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH, CROP_SCALE, CROP_X, CROP_Y, IS_CURRENT, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_USER_PROFILE_IMAGE_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{profileOriginalImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileImagePath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{profileCropScale, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileCropX, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{profileCropY, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, 'Y', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{email})) AND PWD_HASH = #{pwdHash}
SELECT FROM USERS WHERE UPPER(EMAIL) LIKE UPPER('%' || #{email} || '%')
SELECT FROM USERS WHERE UPPER(TRIM(EMAIL)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{email}))
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET STATUS = 'WITHDRAW_PENDING', WITHDRAW_REQUESTED_AT = SYSDATE, WITHDRAW_DEADLINE_AT = SYSDATE + 30 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USERS SET STATUS = 'ACTIVE', WITHDRAW_REQUESTED_AT = NULL, WITHDRAW_DEADLINE_AT = NULL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'WITHDRAW_PENDING' AND WITHDRAW_DEADLINE_AT >= SYSDATE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'WITHDRAW_PENDING' AND WITHDRAW_DEADLINE_AT >= SYSDATE

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PROFILE_IMAGE_ID AS "profileImageId", ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH AS "profileOriginalImagePath", CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH AS "profileImagePath", CROP_SCALE AS "profileCropScale", CROP_X AS "profileCropX", CROP_Y AS "profileCropY", IS_CURRENT AS "isCurrent", TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt" FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, PROFILE_IMAGE_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6

SELECT PROFILE_IMAGE_ID AS "profileImageId", ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH AS "profileOriginalImagePath", CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH AS "profileImagePath", CROP_SCALE AS "profileCropScale", CROP_X AS "profileCropX", CROP_Y AS "profileCropY", IS_CURRENT AS "isCurrent", TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdAt" FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PROFILE_IMAGE_ID = #{profileImageId} AND CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL

SELECT W.WS_ID, W.WS_NAME, W.INVITE_CODE, W.OWNER_ID, W.WS_IMAGE_PATH, W.WS_DESCRIPTION, W.WS_TYPE, W.JOIN_TYPE, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WS_MEMBERS WM WHERE WM.WS_ID = W.WS_ID ) AS memberCount FROM WORKSPACES W JOIN WS_MEMBERS M ON W.WS_ID = M.WS_ID WHERE M.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY W.WS_ID DESC
SELECT LINK_ID, USER_ID, LINK_NAME, LINK_URL, SORT_ORDER FROM USER_PROFILE_LINKS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER ASC, LINK_ID ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USER_PROFILE_LINKS ( LINK_ID, USER_ID, LINK_NAME, LINK_URL, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_USER_PROFILE_LINK_ID.NEXTVAL, #{userId}, #{linkName}, #{linkUrl}, #{sortOrder}, SYSDATE )
